key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0298

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0560
name: open_file_and_read_fields
description: Opens a named file in old-file mode and exits the program with status one if the open fails. It then reads several fixed-width fields from the file into the state record, with a series of read calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0578
name: refresh_stream_record_handle
description: Refreshes a stream record: when its handle is empty or a flag bit is set it obtains a new handle from the stored source, saving it in two fields and returning minus one with error code 12 on failure. Otherwise it clears the position fields and returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:05D4
name: write_char_to_buffered_stream

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0864
name: process_flagged_table_entries
description: Walks a table of eight-byte entries from the last index down to zero and, for each entry whose flag byte is set and whose bit four is clear, calls a routine with its stored value. It finishes by calling another routine with its argument.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:08C0
name: append_string_with_stack_check
description: Appends a limited number of bytes from a source string to a destination string after a stack-space check. It returns the destination pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:08DC
name: append_string_with_limit
description: Appends up to a given number of bytes from a source string to the end of a destination string, then terminates it with a zero byte. It returns the destination pointer.

name: calculate_string_length
description: Returns the number of bytes before the zero terminator of a string.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0948
name: compare_c_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte. It returns one if the first is greater, minus one if smaller, and zero when they are equal.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0968
name: return_block_to_free_list
description: Returns a block of memory to a sorted free list, rounding its size up to a multiple of four with a minimum of eight. It merges the block with adjacent free neighbours and returns minus one when the block overlaps a free block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0A60
name: forward_request_to_record
description: Looks up the record for the first argument and returns minus one when none exists. It then forwards the record's stored pointer with the other two arguments and returns minus one if a global error is set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0AA8
name: open_file_into_free_slot
description: Searches the open-file table from slot three for an empty entry and opens the named file in old or new mode depending on the flags. It returns the slot index, or minus one when no slot is free.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0C28
name: create_directory_then_unlock
description: Creates a directory through the DOS library. On failure it records the DOS error code and returns minus one; on success it releases the directory lock and returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0C64
name: free_linked_list_nodes
description: Walks a singly linked list, freeing each node through the library's memory-free routine. It then clears the list head and tail fields and returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0C94
name: reallocate_sized_buffer
description: Frees the buffer saved in the state record, then allocates a new block of the requested size plus four bytes and stores that size in its first word. It returns a pointer past the size word, or null when the size is zero or allocation fails.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0CE0
name: forward_request_to_record
description: Looks up the record for the first argument and returns minus one when none exists. It then forwards the record's stored pointer with the other two arguments and returns minus one if a global error is set.

name: allocate_list_node
description: Allocates a node of the requested size plus twelve bytes through the memory library, initialises its size and link fields and appends it to the state's linked list. It returns a pointer past the header, or null when allocation fails.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0D94

description: Finds a free block of at least the requested size in a sorted free list, with the size rounded up to a multiple of four and a minimum of eight. It splits off the remainder when it is large enough, updates the free-byte counter and returns the block, or null when none fits.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0E58

name: flush_flagged_stream_nodes

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0ED4
name: write_and_record_dos_error

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0F20

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0F94
name: read_with_dos_error_record
description: Reads from the DOS file through the library after flushing any pending data. A failed read stores the DOS error code, sets the error status to five and returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0FE0

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:1028
name: probe_path_lock_or_open

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:108C

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:10F4
name: close_dos_handle_if_open
description: Closes the stored DOS file handle when one is open, flushing pending data first, then returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:1118
name: open_intuition_and_show_title
description: Opens the Intuition library and, if that succeeds, copies a length-prefixed string into a local buffer and passes it with fixed window dimensions to a routine. If the library cannot be opened it calls a delay routine first.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:11CC
name: compute_fixed_point_product
description: Multiplies two 32-bit fixed-point values held in registers and returns the product in the same format. It combines the high and low halves of both inputs.
